description: Source code for managing Web Configuration metadata, including parsing configuration files, managing support maps and supplementary documents, and providing APIs for querying support status and properties.

methods.name: initWebcfgProperties
methods.description: Initializes Web configuration properties by parsing a given file, setting supported docs, version, supplementary docs, and support maps.

methods.name: setsupplementaryDocs
methods.description: Sets the supplementary documents string.

methods.name: setsupportedDocs
methods.description: Sets the supported docs string.

methods.name: setsupportedVersion
methods.description: Sets the supported version string.

methods.name: getsupportedDocs
methods.description: Returns the supported docs string.

methods.name: getsupportedVersion
methods.description: Returns the supported version string.

methods.name: getsupplementaryDocs
methods.description: Returns the supplementary documents string.

methods.name: isSubDocSupported
methods.description: Checks if a sub-document is supported based on the support map.

methods.name: isRbusListener
methods.description: Checks if a sub-document supports rbus listener (conditional compilation).

methods.name: get_destination
methods.description: Retrieves the destination associated with a sub-document (conditional compilation).

methods.name: isSupplementaryDoc
methods.description: Checks if a sub-document is marked as a supplementary document.

methods.name: set_global_sdInfoHead
methods.description: Sets the global head of the sub-document support map list.

methods.name: set_global_sdInfoTail
methods.description: Sets the global tail of the sub-document support map list.

methods.name: set_global_spInfoHead
methods.description: Sets the global head of the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: set_global_spInfoTail
methods.description: Sets the global tail of the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: get_global_sdInfoHead
methods.description: Returns the global head of the sub-document support map list.

methods.name: get_global_sdInfoTail
methods.description: Returns the global tail of the sub-document support map list.

methods.name: get_global_spInfoHead
methods.description: Returns the global head of the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: get_global_spInfoTail
methods.description: Returns the global tail of the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: supplementaryDocs
methods.description: Populates the list of supplementary documents from the stored string.

methods.name: displaystruct
methods.description: Displays the current sub-document support map list for debugging.

methods.name: delete_supplementary_list
methods.description: Deletes and frees the list of supplementary documents.
